description: Set-up / payoff combos: a hit that matches a combo's payoff on a target with its set-up status deals x multiplier and consumes the status. Heroes and enemies alike.

fields.name: payoff
fields.help: The hit matches if ANY of these matches. Basic attacks count (physical, weapon damage type, no element).

fields.name: damage_types
fields.help: Physical hits of these types (from the skill or the weapon).

fields.name: ability_types
fields.help: PHYSICAL = any physical hit, MAGICAL = any spell hit.

fields.name: multiplier
fields.help: Damage multiplier for the payoff hit.

fields.name: consume
fields.help: Remove the set-up status after the payoff hit.
